dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.arabic: أهلاً، أنا عندي حجز على اسم نور
dialogue.english: Hello, I have a reservation under the name Nour.

dialogue.speaker: الموظف
dialogue.english: Welcome, one moment please.

dialogue.speaker: الموظف
dialogue.arabic: أيوه لقيت الحجز، أوضة لاتنين، صح؟
dialogue.transliteration: aywa la2eet el-7agz, oDa le-etneen, Sa7?
dialogue.english: Yes, I found the reservation, a room for two, right?

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.english: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.speaker: الموظف
dialogue.english: How many nights will you stay?

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.english: Three nights.

dialogue.speaker: الموظف
dialogue.arabic: تمام، اتفضل المفتاح، الأوضة في الدور التاني
dialogue.transliteration: tamaam, etfaDDal el-muftaa7, el-oDa fid-dawr et-taani
dialogue.english: Alright, here's the key, the room is on the second floor.

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.english: Is breakfast included with the reservation?

dialogue.speaker: الموظف
dialogue.arabic: أيوه طبعاً، من سبعة لعشرة الصبح
dialogue.transliteration: aywa Tab3an, min sab3a le-3ashara eS-Sob7
dialogue.english: Yes of course, from seven to ten in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.english: And where's the elevator?

dialogue.speaker: الموظف
dialogue.english: On your right hand.

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.english: Thanks a lot.

dialogue.speaker: الموظف
dialogue.english: You're welcome, enjoy your stay!

response.arabic: أيوه في، أوضة لاتنين في الدور التالت
response.transliteration: aywa fee, oDa le-etneen fid-dawr et-taalet
response.english: Yes there is, a room for two on the third floor.

pair.english: How much is the price per night?

response.english: One thousand one hundred pounds a night.
